text: The 1778 cleanup fixes useFallback and roomId parameters and changes OTR is_reply to isReply while retaining the native callback method still_secure_cb. Current Matrix code also has DMRoomId, so this evidence does not justify a global acronym-case rule. Recommend matching local JavaScript parameter and documentation names while preserving externally fixed callback names. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Keep chat parameter renames local to the JavaScript contract
